recentItems.title: Michael Martinez makes comeback at PH National Figure Skating Championships
recentItems.description:
MANILA – Two-time Winter Olympian Michael Martinez officially returned to competitive skating at the Philippine National Figure Skating Championships 2026 on Friday at the SM Skating Mall of Asia.

The 30-year-old performed his short program routine in the Senior Men’s Division, marking his comeback to competitive skating since the 2018 Winter Olympics.

Martinez’ performance earned him 53.27 points to rank third heading into the free skate on Saturday.

The two-time Winter Olympian could not help but become emotional after he finished his routine with no falls, taking in the cheers of his supporters and fellow skaters.

“Actually it's not registering. Especially after the first jump. When I landed it, I did not. Like, it did not register. And then one after the other, landing it and doing everything,” Martinez told ABS-CBN News after his performance.

"And then right after, it started to sink in. And I said, oh all that hard work, even though it's been only five weeks, it's paying off. It's great to be back," he added.

The 30-year-old figure skater was overwhelmed with all the support he’s been getting even before stepping back onto the ice.

“It felt really good. And I wanted to cry because I felt like everybody's support and being back and just having to experience this again is such an amazing feeling,” Martinez shared.

“Definitely now it means a lot more, and to see everybody's support is still here, it means a lot. Honestly, it is a flashback from all those young days, and yeah, it feels great,” he said.

Martinez is competing against Brandon Baldoz and U.S. junior national champion Lorenzo Elano, whom he has high hopes for as he sees glimpses of himself in the young figure skater.

“Honestly, I'm very happy for them. I'm really, really, really happy for them, especially Lorenzo. He's doing really, really good. Like I see my younger self in him, and I'm really excited because we have another chance for the next Olympics, so I'm really excited for him,” he said of Elano.

Before performing on the ice, Martinez also showed his support for his students who also competed in the earlier divisions.

“It is exciting because at the same time, it's a good feeling because I get to share my experience and what's my thought process to them and how to handle the nerves better…. I mean, to see them perform a lot better than last year is already a good feeling,” he said.

“I can see it from my students and other skaters. They're getting like, I don't know, hyped up. So hopefully that continues and hopefully it sheds more light to this sport,” Martinez added.

Aside from achieving his personal goals, Martinez said one of the main reasons he decided to return was to generate more awareness and support for figure skating.

“I'm really happy that more skaters are here and competing, and hopefully, they continue to grow and to represent more of our country,” he said.

Martinez will still compete in the free skate on Saturday, but he believes his performance is a good indicator of what’s to come.

“I think I'll just do what I can. It's been only five weeks since my last practice, and I think I'm just gonna do a couple of triples and then just see what I can do and then build from there right after this competition,” he shared.

“I’m actually really excited after this competition because I'm gonna build up my stamina, my program, my choreography, and to be ready for the next competition,” Martinez said.

recentItems.title: TV PATROL: BINI Aiah at Mikha nagkuwento tungkol sa Grammy nomination, BTS concert
recentItems.description:
Nakauwi na sa bansa ang dalawa pang BINI members na sina Aiah at Mikha. 

Kwento nila, hindi sila makapaniwala sa nakuhang nominasyon sa Grammy sa kategoryang Best Asian Pop Performance.

Ibinahagi rin nila ang kanilang experience sa panonood ng concert ng Korean supergroup na BTS sa Taiwan. 

Samantala, bumuhos ang excitement ng fans matapos ianunsyo ang kauna-unahang horror film na pagbibidahan ng Kapamilya actress na si Belle Mariano.

recentItems.title: TV PATROL: 'The Gilded Age' Season 4 puno ng intriga at alitan; mga relasyon masusubok
recentItems.description:
Lalong umiinit ang salpukan ng drama, intriga, pag-ibig at kompetisyon New York society sa pinakabagong season ng historical fiction drama series na 'The Gilded Age.' 

Sentro nito ang 'lavender marriage' nina Oscar at Enid van Rhijn na ginagampanan nina Kelley Curran at Blake Ritson. 

Matinding krisis naman ang pinagdaraanan ng samahan ng power couple na sina George at Bertha Russell, na inagampanan naman nina Carrie Coon at Morgan Specter. 

Masusubok din ang pag-iibigan nina Marian Brook at Larry Russell, na ginagampanan nina Harry Richardson at Louisa Jacobson, na anak ng award-winning actress na si Meryl Streep. 

Samantala, naninibago pa rin si Ada Brook na ginagampanan ng 'Sex and the City” star na si Cynthia Nixon na wala na siya nasa anino ng kanyang kapatid na si Agnes van Rhijn, na ginagampanan naman ni Christine Branski. 

Nagpapatrol, Gretchen Fullido. TV Patrol, Biyernes, 20 Nobyembre 2026

recentItems.title: TV PATROL: Lalaki arestado matapos umanong gahasain ang batang anak ng kinakasama
recentItems.description:
Arestado ang isang lalaki sa Pateros matapos umanong gahasain ang dose-anyos na batang babaeng anak ng kanyang kinakasama. 

Sa imbestigasyon ng pulisya, apat na beses umanong inabuso ng suspek ang bata, kabilang ang tatlong insidente noong November 7. 

Lumalabas sa medico-legal examination na positibong naabuso ang bata.

Mahaharap sa kasong paglabag sa anti-rape law  ang suspek na todo tanggi sa paratang laban sa kanya. 

Nasa pangangalaga na ng tiyahin ang bata at nakatakdang i-turn over sa Department of  Social Welfare and Development para sa kaukulang suporta. 

Nagpapatrol, Eon Sanchez. TV Patrol, biyernes, 20 nobyembre 2026

recentItems.title: TV PATROL: Bonggang Christmas bazaar sa Bocaue, Bulacan dinadagsa
recentItems.description:
Ramdam na ang simoy ng Paskong Pinoy!

Sa Bocaue, Bulacan, patok ang Christmas bazaar na dinagsa ng mga mamimili na hindi na kailangang bunuin ang traffic sa Maynila para sa shopping at food trip.

Para sa iba, pagkakataon ito para sa family bonding, mag-ikot at mamili.

Kaya naman paldo ang halos lahat ng mga stall sa dami ng mga pumunta sa Bocaue Christmas bazaar sa kanilang municipal hall.

Live mula sa Bocaue, Bulacan, nagpapatrol si Lyza Aquino.

TV Patrol, Biyernes, 20 Nobyembre 2026.

recentItems.title: TV PATROL: Marcos, Chinese FM Wang tinalakay ang pagpapahupa ng tensyon sa WPS
recentItems.description:
Hindi man nakapulong ni Pangulong Ferdinand Marcos, Jr. si Chinese President Xi Jinping, nakausap naman niya ang Foreign Minister ng China tungkol sa isyu ng West Philippine Sea. 

Ayon sa Pangulo, suportado ng China ang Code of Conduct sa South China Sea. 

Bukod sa mga opisyal ng gobyerno, nakipagpulong din si Pang. Marcos sa mga opisyal ng ilang malalaking kumpanya sa China. 

Samantala, hindi nakikitang isyu ng pangulo ang pagpapatugtog ng awiting 'Anak' ni Freddie Aguilar sa APEC gala dinner. 

Inamin naman niyang naguguluhan siya sa mga protesta kontra Pax Silica, lalo na't wala pa namang kasunduang pinipirmahan. 

Kaugnay niyan, nilinaw ni Philippine Ambassador to the United States Jose Manuel Romualdez na walang kinalaman ang mga protesta sa hindi pagpirma sa Pax Silica Framework Agreement. 

Mula sa Shenzhen, China, nagpapatrol si Jervis Manahan. TV Patrol, Biyernes, 20 Nobyembre 2026

recentItems.title: TV PATROL: 2 bagong episodes ng educational video series 'Estudyantipid' inilunsad
recentItems.description:
Inilunsad ng Knowledge Channel Foundation, Inc. katuwang ang BPI Foundation ang dalawang bagong episodes ng educational video series na 'Estudyantipid.'

Tampok sa new episodes na “Scam and Fraud (Online Shopping): Add to Cart, Add to Risk” at “Saving Tips: Ang Kaso ng Nawawalang Ipon” ang mga kaalaman, babala at tips kung paano maging wais ang mga kabataan sa paghawak ng pera at kung paano makaiwas sa panloloko online.

Kasabay nito, nai-turn over din ang Knowledge Channel Television sa Vicente Madrigal National High School sa Binangonan, Rizal at iba pang partner schools.

Inaasahang makatutulong ang mga telebisyon bilang dagdag na kagamitang pang-edukasyon sa mga guro at estudyante.

TV Patrol, Biyernes, 20 Nobyembre 2026.

recentItems.title: TV PATROL: Prosekusyon duda sa mga dokumentong isinumite ng Cale88 sa BOI
recentItems.description:
Hinanapan ng prosekusyon ng butas ang mga dokumentong iprinesenta ng depensa bilang patunay na lehitimong exporter ng banana chip ang Cale88, ang kumpaniya na iniuugnay sa asawa ni Vice President Sara Duterte.

Ayon sa prosekusyon, bagamat rehistrado sa Board of Investments ang Cale88, may mga kahina-hinalang detalye sa mga dokumentong isinumite nito sa ahensya.

Sa pagtatanong naman ng isang senator-judge, inamin ng testigo mula sa BOI na walang indikasyon na peke ang Cale88 o pineke ang export figures nito.

Aminado ang depensa na hindi naman bahagi ang Cale88 ng mga akusasyon tungkol sa umano’y 'di maipaliwanag na yaman ng bise dahil ang asawa niyang si Mans Carpio ang nagmamay-ari nito.

Pero iginiit ni defense spokesperson Atty. Michael Poa na mahalaga pa rin para sa kanilang panig na maipaliwanag ang issue sa publiko.

Live mula sa Senado, nagpapatrol si Katrina Domingo. TV Patrol, Biyernes, 20 Nobyembre 2026.

recentItems.title: TV PATROL: PNP: Walang 'rescue' sa 2 dating kasambahay ni Sara Duterte
recentItems.description:
Walang rescue o pagpapalaya sa dalawang dating kasambahay ni Vice President Sara Duterte na nakatanggap umano ng mga banta, ayon sa Philippine National Police. 

Pinag-aaralan namang magsagawa ng hiwalay na imbestigasyon ang National Bureau of Investigation sa umano'y pananakot at pamimilit sa kanilang lumagda sa isang affidavit kontra sa bise. 

Giit ng PNP, nakipag-ugnayan sa kanila ang dalawang abogado para sunduin ang mga naturang tauhan na nakatanggap umano ng mga banta.

Nagpapatrol, Karen de Guzman. TV Patrol, Biyernes, 20 Nobyembre 2026.
